uiDialogBox-interval.label: Print Interval
uiDialogBox-interval.tip: If set to 0, all text will be printed at once. Otherwise, the text will be printed continuously at intervals until finished or the current page is filled.

uiDialogBox-letterSpacing-box.label: Letter Spacing
uiDialogBox-letterSpacing-box.tip: Letter spacing on the same line.

uiDialogBox-font.label: Font
uiDialogBox-font.tip: Enter the font name. If there are multiple fonts, separate them with commas in order of preference.

uiDialogBox-typeface.label: Typeface
uiDialogBox-typeface.tip: Select the style of the text.

bold-italic.name: Bold Italic
bold-italic.tip: Both bold and italic are applied.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.tip: Render the text as a shadow at a specified offset position.

stroke.name: Stroke
stroke.tip: Render the text outline with a specified width, with half the width hidden by the text.

outline.name: Outline
outline.tip: Render the text outline four times at a 1-pixel offset in all directions.

uiDialogBox-blend.label: Blend
uiDialogBox-blend.tip: Choose a blending mode to combine the color with the underlying color.
